overview.en: This short chapter applies Bandura's self-efficacy theory to NCLEX preparation. It guides you through self-reflection, goal setting, a structured study plan, self-care and a calm approach to the final days and exam day.
overview.zh: 本章將班杜拉自我效能理論應用於 NCLEX 備考，引導自我反思、設定目標、結構化讀書計畫、自我照顧，以及最後階段與考試日的穩定心態。

points.en: Self-efficacy is a belief in your own ability to carry out particular behaviors; it shapes which behaviors you choose, how long you persevere and how well you perform.
points.zh: 自我效能是相信自己有能力執行特定行為；它影響你選擇的行為、堅持程度與表現品質。

points.en: High self-efficacy expectations lead to hard work and persistence; low expectations lead to self-doubt about passing.
points.zh: 高自我效能期望促使努力與堅持；低期望則導致對通過考試的自我懷疑。

points.en: Research (Silvestri, Clark and Moonie, 2013) found self-efficacy expectations were an important predictor of NCLEX success.
points.zh: 研究（Silvestri 等，2013）顯示自我效能期望是 NCLEX 成功的重要預測因子。

points.en: Self-reflection lets you review past experiences and build confidence about your capabilities.
points.zh: 自我反思讓你回顧過往經驗並建立對能力的信心。

points.en: Journal your accomplishments and re-read them whenever doubt appears.
points.zh: 記錄你的成就，疑慮出現時重新閱讀。

points.en: Ask yourself about goal setting: are goals realistic, do you reach them, how do you overcome obstacles?
points.zh: 自問目標設定：目標是否務實、是否達成、遇到障礙如何克服？

points.en: Foundation: strong positive attitude, sense of self-efficacy, self-control, and short- and long-term goals.
points.zh: 基礎：積極態度、自我效能感、自我控制，以及短期與長期目標。

points.en: Calm yourself with slow breathing (inhale through the nose, hold for 4, exhale slowly through the mouth).
points.zh: 以緩慢呼吸平靜自己（鼻吸、屏息數到 4、嘴慢慢吐氣）。

points.en: Write the List of goals (today, tomorrow, next month, future), set it aside 2-3 days, then review it.
points.zh: 寫下目標清單（今天、明天、下個月、未來），擱置 2-3 天後再檢視。

heading.en: Plan for preparation and study schedule

points.en: Choose the study pattern that has worked for you before (alone vs group, time of day, place).
points.zh: 選擇過去有效的讀書模式（獨自或小組、時段、地點）。

points.en: Schedule at least 2 hours of quality, uninterrupted study daily on a calendar; quality matters more than quantity.
points.zh: 在行事曆排定每天至少 2 小時不被打擾的高品質讀書時間；重質不重量。

points.en: Share your plan with family and friends; protect study time when others pressure you to skip it.
points.zh: 與家人朋友分享計畫；他人勸你跳過時要守住讀書時間。

points.en: Self-assess strong and weak content areas, then start practice questions in weaker areas.
points.zh: 自我評估強弱項目，從較弱領域開始做題。

points.en: Note unfamiliar content and review it in your review book and textbooks after each session.
points.zh: 記下不熟的內容，每次讀完後翻閱複習書與教科書補強。

points.en: Practice at least 4000 questions; start in Study Mode, read every rationale and strategy, then move to Exam Mode to check readiness.
points.zh: 至少練習 4000 題；先用學習模式、閱讀每題解析與策略，再用考試模式檢測準備度。

heading.en: Positive pampering, final preparation and exam day
heading.zh: 正向照顧自己、最後準備與考試日

points.en: Include exercise, healthy eating, water, complex carbohydrates, limited caffeine and fun in your schedule.
points.zh: 排入運動、健康飲食、足量飲水、複合碳水化合物、限制咖啡因及休閒活動。

points.en: End studying 2 days before the exam and rest the day before; avoid perfectionism.
points.zh: 考前 2 天結束複習，前一天好好休息；避免完美主義。

points.en: Do a test drive to the testing center; post your name with RN and the exam date.
points.zh: 事先試開到考場；貼出你的名字加上 RN 與考試日期。

points.en: Exam day: eat a nutritious breakfast, breathe, believe, stay in control and visualize RN after your name.
points.zh: 考試日：吃營養早餐，呼吸、相信自己、保持掌控，想像名字後面有 RN。

critical_points.en: Self-efficacy is a significant predictor of NCLEX success.
critical_points.zh: 自我效能是 NCLEX 成功的重要預測因子。

critical_points.en: Plan at least 2 hours of quality study daily.
critical_points.zh: 每天規劃至少 2 小時高品質讀書時間。

critical_points.en: Practice at least 4000 questions before the exam.
Read rationales and test-taking strategies for every question, right or wrong.
critical_points.zh: 每題都要讀解析與策略，無論對錯。

critical_points.en: Start with weaker content areas and keep notes on unfamiliar topics.
critical_points.zh: 從較弱領域開始並記錄不熟的主題。

critical_points.en: Use Study Mode first, then Exam Mode to judge readiness.
critical_points.zh: 先用學習模式，再用考試模式評估準備度。

critical_points.en: Stop studying 2 days before the exam; rest the day before.
critical_points.zh: 考前 2 天停止讀書；前一天休息。

critical_points.en: Do a test drive to the testing center beforehand.

mnemonics.en: Day-of-exam cue: Breathe, Believe, Control, Believe, Visualize.
mnemonics.zh: 考試日口訣：呼吸、相信、掌控、相信、想像（Breathe-Believe-Control-Believe-Visualize）。

stem.en: A nursing graduate says, "I always doubt I will pass." According to self-efficacy theory, which approach is most helpful?
stem.zh: 一位護理畢業生說：「我總覺得自己會考不過。」依自我效能理論，哪種作法最有幫助？

options.en: Journal past accomplishments and set realistic goals
options.zh: 記錄過往成就並設定務實目標

rationale.en: Self-reflection on achievements builds self-efficacy expectations and persistence.
rationale.zh: 對成就的反思能建立自我效能期望與堅持。

stem.en: Which are recommended parts of an NCLEX study plan? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 下列哪些是建議的 NCLEX 讀書計畫內容？（複選）

options.en: At least 2 hours of uninterrupted study daily
options.zh: 每天至少 2 小時不受打擾的讀書

options.en: Reading rationales only for incorrect answers
Studying until the last minute before the exam

rationale.en: Rationales should be read for every question; study should stop 2 days before the exam.
rationale.zh: 每題都應閱讀解析；應於考前 2 天停止讀書。

stem.en: How many practice questions does the chapter recommend completing before taking the NCLEX?
stem.zh: 本章建議在考前至少完成多少練習題？

rationale.en: The chapter advises at least 4000 practice questions.

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: What should the candidate do on the day before the examination?
stem.zh: 考前一天考生應做什麼？

options.zh: 休息並從事喜歡的活動

rationale.en: The mind needs rest; the study plan ends 2 days before.
rationale.zh: 大腦需要休息；讀書計畫於前 2 天結束。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A friend invites the candidate to a movie during scheduled study time. Which is the best response?
stem.zh: 朋友在預定讀書時間邀約看電影。最佳回應為何？

options.en: Go; there is plenty of time later
Weigh the goal and positive momentum and keep the study schedule
options.zh: 考量目標與正向動能，維持讀書時程

rationale.en: The chapter stresses keeping the goal in mind and protecting momentum.
rationale.zh: 本章強調牢記目標並維持動能。
